info.title: Animeko TV Remote Settings
info.description: Process-scoped LAN configuration service. All routes require the QR bearer key. Mutations use an operation UUID and conditional resource revision; accepted operations can finish after the requesting connection closes. Request bodies are limited to 2 MiB.
